gloss: to stay behind; to remain after others leave

definitions.gloss: to stay behind; to remain after others leave
definitions.explanation: To stay in a place after others have left — typically at work after hours, at school after class, or at any group activity. Often implies obligation rather than choice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{居残|いのこ}って⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I stayed behind today to work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{生徒|せいと}→生徒：01051_seito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{居残|いのこ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The students are staying behind to clean.

examples.japanese: ⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{間|ま}に{合|あ}わせる→間に合う：01142_maniau⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧{数名|すうめい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おそ}く→遅い：00533_osoi⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{居残|いのこ}って⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧た。
examples.english: To meet the deadline, a few employees stayed behind working until late.

notes:
Compound of {居|い}る (to be present, to stay) + ⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧ (to remain). Class: godan verb (る → り/った). The intransitive pairing of ⟦{残|のこ}す→残す：01975_nokosu⟧ (transitive).

TRANSITIVITY: Intransitive. The subject stays behind on their own.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {居残|いのこ}って⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to work overtime / stay behind to work
- {居残|いのこ}り⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧: studying after class (often as discipline at school)
- ⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{居残|いのこ}る: to be the only one left behind
- ⟦{遅|おそ}く→遅い：00533_osoi⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{居残|いのこ}る: to stay behind until late

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{残業|ざんぎょう}→残業：01071_zangyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to work overtime — specifically work, more common in business contexts
- {居残|いのこ}り: noun form, the act/penalty of staying behind (school setting)
- ⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧: to remain — broader, includes inanimate things; does not specifically mean staying after others leave
